Neftchi vs Xorazm Live Stream: Kickoff Time, How to Watch & Match Preview

Match Overview

Neftchi host Xorazm at Istiqlol Stadium on 7 October 2026 for a Uzbekistan Super League fixture. The match is scheduled to kick off at 14:00 UTC. Neftchi enter the game as league leaders, while Xorazm are fighting to avoid relegation.

Istiqlol Stadium, located in Fergana, has a capacity of around 20,000 and serves as the home ground for Neftchi. The venue has hosted numerous Uzbek league encounters and is known for its passionate atmosphere.

With Neftchi top of the table on 51 points and Xorazm 14th on 21 points, the result could have significant implications for both sides’ seasonal objectives.
